title: Supported finite-stage local systems do not detect the coefficient-topology scalar-unit defect
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, a separated finite-type $k$-scheme $X$ [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], and an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its extended $\ell$-adic norm topology. On profinite sets with finite jointly surjective covers let
$$C(S)=\{f\in C(S,\Omega):f(S)\subset E\text{ for some finite }\mathbf Q_\ell\subset E\subset\Omega\},\qquad B(S)=C(S,\Omega).$$
These are the coefficient rings of [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed, def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring]. Put $C_T=p_T^*C$, $B_T=p_T^*B$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and let $c_T:C_T\to B_T$ be induced by inclusion. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories of internal modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects, sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. Write $J_X=B_X\otimes^L_{C_X}-$ and $U_X=\operatorname{Res}_{c_X}$, and let $\eta:\mathrm{id}\to U_XJ_X$ be their derived adjunction unit [sk-def-sfb-derived-extension-of-scalars], represented on a K-flat resolution by $v\mapsto1\otimes v$.

Choose two constructible locally closed immersions $a:S\hookrightarrow X$, $b:T\hookrightarrow X$ [def-constructible-stratification, def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-closed-immersion]. Define $a_!=i_*j_!$ after factoring $a=i\circ j$ into an open immersion into its closure followed by the closed immersion, and likewise for $b$, using the exact coefficient-module functors of [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-open-closed-recollement]. Choose finite intermediate fields $E,F\subset\Omega$, and lisse modules $L$ over $A_{E,S}=p_S^*C(-,E)$ and $M$ over $A_{F,T}=p_T^*C(-,F)$ [def-sfb-lisse-coefficient-module], with the restricted norm topologies [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring]. Set
$$G=a_!\bigl(C_S\otimes^L_{A_{E,S}}L[0]\bigr),\qquad H=b_!\bigl(C_T\otimes^L_{A_{F,T}}M[0]\bigr).$$
For every distinguished triangle $H\xrightarrow{\eta_H}U_XJ_XH\to Q_H\to H[1]$ [def-weil-triangulated-category] and every integer $n$,
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\operatorname{Mod}_{C_X})}(G,Q_H[n])=0.$$
Both supports, both finite fields and both local systems vary independently. Empty supports and rank-zero local systems are included. This is a statement only about these two finite-stage supported local systems and the specified scalar unit; it imposes no flatness on $c_X$.
